methods.name: Cued retrieval
methods.description: Recall the meaning from a cue.

methods.name: Keyword mnemonic

methods.name: Example sentence
methods.description: Learn the word in a sentence.

variants.cued_retrieval: voma means river. Cover the meaning and recall it from voma.
variants.keyword_mnemonic: voma means river. Picture foam beside the river.
variants.example_sentence: voma means river. We saw a river; in this language we saw a voma.

check.prompt: Give the English meaning of voma.

practice.prompt: Say voma aloud and recall its meaning.
